name: Forever Time
source:
I wish this moment could be forever. Yuto Habu, the hero with nothing to show for it, met the camera-toting heroine He meets the heroine, Nazuna Fukamachi, who has a camera, on a bridge with a beautiful view by chance.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3278330/Forever_Time/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
真希望这一瞬间能够化作永恒。一事无成的男主角羽生优斗，在一座风景优美的桥上偶然邂逅了手拿相机的女主角深町荠。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3278330/Forever_Time/]Steam[/url]]
